verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Elastic Observability has alerting rules and can send notifications "via services or third-party incident management systems." No evidence item documents registrable outbound webhook (HTTP callback) connectors. Nothing shows alerts triggering automated remediation or agents. Generic third-party notification integrations do not qualify as webhooks under this story, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point alert notifications at webhooks that trigger automated remediation or agents
